ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels against a ~92-95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) ventral field.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark background; high-contrast white pixels localized in small circular rings (5-15px diameter) across both lobes, and dense white clusters at the distal tips and medial notch margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression, approximately 35 degrees, with a deep bounding-box penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; right lobe (viewer perspective) shows larger sawtooth peaks (5-10px amplitude) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges tapering to distal tips; trailing edges exhibit a roughly linear trajectory from notch to mid-lobe before curving toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white rings (rosettes) scattered across both lobes; concentrated cluster visible in the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel white/grey linear marks; distinct long diagonal scratch on the left lobe and horizontal rake-like marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical reddish-brown linear lesion or tissue exposure located centrally on the caudal peduncle at the fluke insertion point.
other_distinctive_markers: Bright white stippling/mottling concentrated specifically along the interior margins of the median notch.
